text: A cluster only one person can operate is still a single point of failure. This video writes down three documents so any on-call DBA can run this environment.
An AG failover runbook with a membership pre-check, a new-database checklist, and a platform inventory covering both SQL Server and MongoDB -- what's backed up, what's monitored, and who owns it.

The checklist exists because of ProductionSchedulingDB: adding a database to BrennanAG now gets its own named, unskippable line, verified by the next AGMembershipCheck run before anyone calls it production-ready.

The runbook's pre-failover check now asks the exact question that incident exposed: is every database that's supposed to be protected actually showing as a member, right now, not just configured once.
All three live on the shared ops wiki, walked through live with the on-call DBA. Next: the honest, closing accounting of this whole engagement.
